title: Unknown spawn-class fail-loud path (lower_spawns) has zero test coverage — the 3.3 error contract is unpinned
detail: The new optional spawn-class path's error branch is never exercised: no demo uses an invalid class and the harness has no negative case. The drift-check precedent ("the gate's rejects drift must be PROVEN in CI, not just asserted locally") is not followed for the review-F5 fail-loud fix — a regression to silent demand truncation would pass CI.
recommended_fix: Add a negative pin: a unit test calling lower_spawns with an unknown class asserting the error propagates through demo_apply_setup (or a deliberately-bad demo asserted to fail harness run).

title: Spatial-lane render guard paths (zero-share stroke skip, ppm<=0 freeze) are untested and unreachable with current catalog data
detail: No test pins lane_bands (pure, deterministic) or the two guards: all three lane_presets (balanced/express_heavy/best_effort_heavy) have strictly positive weights and palette lane_speeds are positive, so no golden can ever exercise a zero-width stroke or a frozen lane. App-layer coverage is golden-only (zero app unit tests).
recommended_fix: Unit-test lane_bands directly: zero caps -> all widths 0 (no strokes), widths proportional to share, band centers abut; and a palette lane_speeds=0 row for the frac=0 freeze.

title: palette lane_speeds whole-array fallback has no test — the anti-freeze guard is unpinned
detail: The fallback exists precisely because "a partial parse would freeze one lane at speed 0 silently" (comment, palette.odin:91-92), yet neither the happy parse nor the fallback is test-pinned; only the valid palette.json is ever rendered by goldens. Cosmetic-only, but the hazard the guard prevents is real.
recommended_fix: Add palette_load test rows: malformed lane_speeds (wrong arity, one non-integer) must yield the {1000, 850, 700} defaults; valid [1000, 850, 700] parses through.

title: Spec code map attributes a 'replay-with-drops pin' to qos_test.odin — the replay pin there runs zero demand (no drops)
detail: test_qos_replay_byte_identical never seeds demand (no flow_seed_demand/queue_packet), so the run produces zero drops — the E10-with-drops acceptance ('every drop emits Packet_Dropped{class, reason} and the run replays byte-identically') is actually pinned by the harness replay gate on qos_contention (drops occur there; per-tick hashes include drop events). Coverage exists; the spec's attribution does not hold.
recommended_fix: Correct the code map: name the harness replay gate on qos_contention as the replay-with-drops pin (or add a demand-seeded replay case to qos_test.odin).

title: qos_contention.dem oversubscription comment (~2.4x) does not hold at byte level — actual demand/capacity is ~4x
evidence:
demos/qos_contention.dem:3:
# ~2.4x with two classes the PLAYER categorized (canon 2026-08-12 — nothing
balance.json _comment: "transit ticks = ceil(packet_bandwidth / pipe.capacity_units), so a standard pipe (cap 15) takes 2 ticks" -> 30 u/packet / 15 u/tick = 10 pkt/s on pipe 0.
demos/qos_contention.dem:22-27: email at 500/550/600ms (every 50 ms = 20/s) + streaming at 525/575/625ms (every 50 ms = 20/s) = 40 pkt/s aggregate on pipe 0.
detail: 40 pkt/s demand vs 10 pkt/s capacity = 4.0x oversubscribed, not ~2.4x. The demo still saturates (per-lane bound 6 + E9 sheds engage well before the 3000ms capture), so this is a comment-only inaccuracy, not a functional defect.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment (and the briefing's echoed figure) to ~4x, or re-derive the intended 2.4x basis (e.g. per-direction demand) and state it.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100%: E7 floor + lone-packet full-capacity + no-starvation (qos_test.odin:431/443/471), E9 all 21 combos (503-562) + double-shed splice (663-696), E22 strict-priority A/B/C (579-650), replay-with-drops via the qos_contention replay gate (goldens/qos_contention.log.bin + .t1, 240 ticks), tag-conditional sparse pin (206-283), light-demo T1 manifests (11 demos, uniform catalog_hash afe505119369d195), balance-key fail-fast rows (catalog_test.odin:203-206), qos_contention T1+T2(3 captures)+replay gate. P1 100%. Overall ~92%: gaps confined to one P2 harness error path + two P3 cosmetic guard paths (findings above).
recommended_fix: Raise to a clean pass: pin the unknown spawn-class error path (warning above) and add the lane_bands/palette-fallback unit rows — each is a few lines against already-existing test scaffolding.
